threatModel.summary: Vibe Route is a Vue 3/Vite SPA plus FastAPI/async-SQLAlchemy service for ingesting, storing, editing, visualizing, exporting, and sharing GPX/CSV/XLSX/KML/KMZ tracks. It uses bearer JWTs in localStorage, owner-scoped track APIs, public share and poster capability routes, live-recording upload tokens, generated media under /exports, and SQLite by default with optional MySQL/PostgreSQL. HTTP is supported and HTTPS is an external deployment option. [frontend/src/stores/auth.ts:9-26; backend/app/main.py:371-391; backend/app/core/config.py:36-95]
